title: Richard Byworth: Bitcoin’s Next Run “Just a Mater of Time” thanks to Seller Exhaustion
summary: Bitcoin Magazine Richard Byworth: Bitcoin’s Next Run “Just a Mater of Time” thanks to Seller Exhaustion Can you earn yield on Bitcoin safely? Richard Byworth warns against covered calls in rallies, making the case for basis trades for market-neutral yield. This post Richard Byworth: Bitcoin’s Next Run “Just a Mater of Time” thanks to Seller Exhaustion first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Patrick Green .
